kill_condition: Retire unchanged single-prototype prior-page bypass on any identity failure, gross gain below 3000 B/M, net gain below 2100 B/M, failure to beat E1 or ER, or nonpositive selection or sealed-confirmation exact gain; do not sweep minimum length, integer codes, distance windows, or prototype count.

rejection_reason: Exact opening-1M Q0 searched all 171 complete pages and 14,535 prior-page pairs; no page retained a positive net COPY plan after the frozen page reference and finite command cost. Parent payload, command, WRT, raw inverse, and deterministic archive proofs passed. Retire unchanged single-prototype Route E without rescue sweeps.
